text:
We opened by naming the moment. On 2025-01-03, seventy-one of us said "the 119th congress," and thirty-five said "in the 119th congress"; Ed Case had first said it back on 2023-01-03. That was our largest convergence.

Fifty of us said "israel and hamas," peaking 2025-01-15, with forty-two saying "between israel and hamas"; Jared F. Golden had first said it on 2023-10-12.

Late in the month, on 2025-01-28, thirty-four of us said "management and budget" and thirty-three "of management and budget," alongside twenty-seven saying "grants and loans."

On 2025-01-06, thirty-one of us said "four years ago."

We record these as the phrases we repeated together, and the counts of how many of us said each. The dates we shared them are above. This is our record for the era, and we let it stand as it is.
